input.encoding: [m, n] where m is the symmetric A dimension and row count of B/C, n is the column count of B/C

output.meaning: row-major sum of all final C[i][j] values after the source-order SYMM update

source_bound.description: The pinned PolyBench/C launcher selects EXTRALARGE_DATASET (M=2000, N=2600). This bounded profile accepts m,n in 1..64. It uses alpha=1.5, beta=1.2; initializes C[i][j]=((i+j) mod 100)/m and B[i][j]=((n+i-j) mod 100)/m; initializes A's lower triangle and diagonal to ((i+j) mod 100)/m and its unused upper triangle to -999; and follows the original increasing i,j,k order and update expressions. The source dumps all of final C, while this scalar ABI reports its row-major binary64 sum.
